items.title: a generic enum's variant as a LIST or TUPLE element or as a method receiver hovers bare - `Some` in `[Some(1), None]`, `(Some("a"), 2)` and `Some(4).map(..)` read `Option::Some`, with no instantiation and no payload
items.body: `variant_use_labels` (hover_labels.rs) settles a variant's instantiation from the return slot, an annotation, the initialized binding's type and a plain call's declared parameter (E317, E328); a container element and a receiver have none of those facts. Read the element type from the container's recorded type (the list's or tuple's `expr_types` row) and the receiver's from the member call's subject type. Pin: the three shapes with `Some`, `None`, `Ok`, `Err`.

items.discussion: editor-54 (Order 54); `VILAN_EDITOR_KOLT=<kolt copy> cargo nextest run -p vilan-lsp --run-ignored only the_view_exhibit_tracks`
items.title: the `#[ignore]`d E126 gate `keystroke::gate::the_view_exhibit_tracks_the_recorded_application_shape` fails on its own generated exhibit: `Combine<(str, i32)> has no method 'map'` (the exhibit must analyze clean)
items.body: Run at the editor-54 tip (the change is rows and labels only); not run at the base, so it may predate Order 54. The generated `view1791` exhibit uses a `Combine` method std no longer has (or has under another name/import); the gate asserts a clean analysis before its census, so it asserts nothing until the generator is updated. Also: the ignored `leak_soak_corpus_plateaus` and `cancellation_measurement_on_an_external_subject` need VILAN_PERF_KOLT / VILAN_M26_SUBJECT (documented, not failures).
